command:
mkdir -p /tmp/ansible-sudo-log && cat > /tmp/ansible-sudo-log/playbook.yml <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
---
- name: Log sudo commands to a dedicated file, out of the general system log
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Create sudo command log file with restrictive permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /var/log/sudo-commands.log
        state: touch
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0600"
        access_time: preserve
        modification_time: preserve

    - name: Install sudoers drop-in to log commands with user/timestamp to dedicated file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-command-logging
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0440"
        content: |
          Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log"
          Defaults log_year
          Defaults !syslog
        validate: "visudo -cf %s"

    - name: Ensure rsyslog/syslog does not also capture sudo (authpriv) entries separately
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /etc/rsyslog.d
      register: rsyslog_dir
ANTRIEB_EOF
echo "exit=$?"
